notes: ARC1-006 is the active ticket: fix the per-scene budget for JS, textures, audio, memory, draw calls and time. /arc-plan narrows this contract to the exact artifacts when it writes the ficha, exactly as versions 5 and 7 did for ARC1-004 and ARC1-005.
ARC1-005 closed DONE with two packets. ARC1-005-A froze SCENE_INVENTORY.md; ARC1-005-B froze CONTENT_V2.md. Both move from director/write to protected, consistent with CP-019.

Frozen canon is now seven documents: GOLDEN_FRAMES.md, IDENTITY.md and LEGAL_REFERENCES.md from ARC1-003 (CP-015); COLOR_SCRIPT.md and SHOT_DECK.md from ARC1-004 (CP-018); SCENE_INVENTORY.md and CONTENT_V2.md from ARC1-005 (CP-019). Protected means no ticket may edit them to make its own result pass; amending requires its own CP decision, not a ticket.

Precedence on conflict: GOLDEN_FRAMES.md beats SHOT_DECK.md; the earlier frozen document beats the later one; SCENE_INVENTORY.md may report that COLOR_SCRIPT.md does not cover a beat, but may not redefine its beat map.

ARC1-006 budgets over the five scenes of SCENE_INVENTORY.md, not over zones or golden frames. The minimal overworld of ARC1-010 has no duration allocated and no scene: ARC1-006 must decide whether it gets its own budget line.

cards.ts stays in src/**, protected. CONTENT_V2.md verifies and freezes those six V2 sheets; it does not own them. ARC1-018, ARC1-019, ARC1-021 and ARC1-022 implement them and may not reinterpret their values.

SHOT_DECK.md section 2 makes the safe areas binding. The mobile HUD currently fails it by a measured margin (evidence/ARC1-004/hud-rects.json). Fixing it belongs to ARC1-026. Do not correct it opportunistically.

OI-002 and OI-003 are open, both P2, both about scene E2 (Ohm activation, Beat 3): it has no route anchor, no golden frame, no protected camera subject and no sheet describing its initial phenomenon. Destinations ARC1-011 and ARC1-015. Converting an OI into a ticket is the Director's call, never the executor's (CP-002).
H3_CONTRACT.md is authorized and frozen; amending it requires a new CP decision.
builder and reviewer get append-only access to OPEN_ISSUES.md and telemetry.json (CP-017). Append-only means adding a row or a record; never editing or deleting existing ones.

Rotating this contract is step E of EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md, executed at close. Version 8 was written as part of closing ARC1-005, not when opening ARC1-006: that is the fix CP-017 introduced after OI-001.
